I'm a Master of Business Analytics student at Monash University in Melbourne. Before moving into data, I worked in finance and founded my own clothing brand, Va&eacute; Lour.

Running a small business taught me that numbers only matter when someone can act on them. That's what this blog is for: explaining evidence from research in plain language, for readers who don't have a statistics background.
